metadata.description: Tooling distilled from real delivery work — each plugin here was extracted from a project that already paid for the mistakes it prevents.

plugins.name: k3s-azure
plugins.description: Operate a small-team k3s cluster on Azure: investigate an incident from symptom to the commit that caused it, run Terraform against a hard cost ceiling, reach the cluster without a tunnel, and keep observability inside a daily ingestion cap.
